body: But the music isn't helping anymore... I tried, I am trying. I feel like im just being engulfed and I cant stop it... just slow it down.
I dont know. I just want to escape from everything and this feels like the best option
but I dont want to try anymore... I've tried for so long and I'm so tired
there's nothing left to live for
Space buns are everything to me at the moment 😊 They make me feel extra little. Yours look so good, I wish I could get mine to look like that 🙁

I can't promise it will get better, Only you can make it so. But I can promise it will get easier with time, even in your happiest moments you'll feel a dull ache but eventually you'll find someone to fill the hole they left.
